blocks.html:
Executes cross-module graph queries by resolving relationships from module
joiner configs.

Pipeline: GraphCatalog (index configs) → compileQuery
(query → plan) → executePlan (fetch + join + shortcuts).

Data loading is delegated to IRemoteDataFetcher (typically
ModuleDataFetcher). Query is the public entry point that normalizes user
input and invokes [RemoteJoiner.query](/references/modules_sdk/classes/modules_sdk.RemoteJoiner#query).

children.name: schema
children.description: GraphQL schema for the all module's available entities and fields

children.name: alias
children.description: The alias used to reference the related service in queries.

children.name: foreignKey
children.description: The foreign key field on the related service used to join the relationship.

children.name: primaryKey
children.description: The primary key field on the current service used to join the relationship.

children.name: serviceName
children.description: The name of the related service.

children.name: entity
children.description: The entity name within the related service.

children.name: inverse
children.description: In an inverted relationship the foreign key is on the other service and the primary key is on the current service

children.name: isList
children.description: Force the relationship to return a list

children.name: args
children.description: Extra arguments to pass to the remoteFetchData callback

children.name: deleteCascade
children.description: If true, the link joiner will cascade deleting the relationship

children.name: filterable
children.description: The fields to be filterable by the Index module using query.index

children.name: hasMany
children.description:
Allow multiple relationships to exist for this
entity

children.name: isLink
children.description: If the module is a link module

children.name: linkableKeys
children.description: Keys that can be used to link to other modules. e.g { product\_id: "Product" } "Product" being the entity it refers to

children.name: isReadOnlyLink
children.description: If true it expands a RemoteQuery property but doesn't create a pivot table

children.name: extraDataFields
children.description:
Fields that will be part of the link record aside from the primary keys that can be updated
If not explicitly defined, this array will be populated by databaseConfig.extraFields

children.name: tableName
children.description: Name of the pivot table. If not provided it is auto generated

children.name: idPrefix
children.description: Prefix for the id column. If not provided it is "link"

types.name: queryObj
types.description: A query object used by the remote joiner to fetch and join data across services.

children.name: service
children.description: The name of the service to query.

children.name: alias
children.description: The alias of the service entry point to query.

children.name: expands
children.description: Nested relationships to expand in the query result.

children.name: property
children.description: The property path to the relationship to expand.

children.name: fields
children.description: The fields to retrieve for the expanded relationship.

children.name: args
children.description: Arguments to pass to the expanded relationship query.

children.name: directives
children.description: Directives to apply to fields in the expanded relationship.

children.name: fields
children.description: The fields to retrieve from the queried service.

children.name: args
children.description: Arguments to pass to the service query.

children.name: name
children.description: The name of the argument.

children.name: value
children.description: The value of the argument.

children.name: directives
children.description: Directives to apply to fields in the query.

types.name: options
types.description: Options controlling the behavior of a remote joiner query execution.

children.name: throwIfKeyNotFound
children.description: Whether to throw an error if a requested key is not found in the result.

children.name: throwIfRelationNotFound
children.description: Whether to throw an error if a requested relation is not found, or a list of relation names to check.

children.name: initialData
children.description: Initial data to use as the starting dataset for the query instead of fetching from a service.

children.name: initialDataOnly
children.description: Whether to use only the initial data without fetching additional data from services.

children.name: locale
children.description:
The locale to use for the query.
Translation will be applied to the query result based on the locale.

children.name: enable
children.description:
Whether to enable the cache. This is only useful if you want to enable without providing any
other options or if you want to enable/disable the cache based on the arguments.

children.name: key
children.description:
The key to use for the cache.
If a function is provided, it will be called with the arguments as the first argument and the
container as the second argument.

children.name: tags
children.description: The tags to use for the cache.

children.name: ttl
children.description: The time-to-live (TTL) value in seconds.

children.name: autoInvalidate
children.description: Whether to auto invalidate the cache whenever it is possible.

children.name: providers
children.description: The providers to use for the cache.
